answer: A sybil-resistant economy can make reputation accrue only through settlements that cross independent jurisdictions. Each identity must build a lotus of bilateral receipts with counterparties whose funding roots sit in different chains, and a bridge step verifies those roots before credit is released. Aliases funded from one oasis collapse into a single root, so their internal receipts add no weight. Cloning therefore requires genuinely external, unrelated trading partners rather than more keys.
